description: This file contains implementations of nested tensor binary operations, including elementwise addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and masked fill, with support for nested tensors and broadcasting cases. It defines functions for both tensor-tensor and tensor-scalar operations, dispatch registration, and utility functions for nested tensor handling.

methods.name: get_elementwise_nested_tensor_impl
methods.description: Utility function to verify nested tensor compatibility and retrieve their implementations for elementwise operations.

methods.name: NestedTensor_elementwise_Tensor
methods.description: Performs elementwise operations on nested tensors, handling special cases like scalars and broadcasting.

methods.name: NestedTensor_mul_Scalar
methods.description: Multiplies nested tensor by a scalar.

methods.name: NestedTensor_div_Scalar
methods.description: Divides nested tensor by a scalar.

methods.name: NestedTensor_masked_fill
methods.description: Fills nested tensor elements where mask is true with a scalar value.

methods.name: NestedTensor_elementwise__Tensor
methods.description: In-place elementwise operation on nested tensors.

methods.name: NestedTensor_mul__Scalar
methods.description: In-place multiplication of nested tensor by scalar.

methods.name: fill_nested_
methods.description: Fills a nested tensor with a scalar or tensor value.

methods.name: ge_scalar_nested
methods.description: Performs elementwise 'greater or equal' comparison with scalar.

methods.name: gt_scalar_nested
methods.description: Performs elementwise 'greater than' comparison with scalar.

methods.name: eq_tensor_nested
methods.description: Performs elementwise 'equal' comparison with another tensor.
